newsitem.title: USA: GENICOM, Digital in talks on printing business.
newsitem.headline: GENICOM, Digital in talks on printing business.

text.p: Computer printer technology company GENICOM Corp. is in talks with computer company Digital Equipment Corp. concerning a possible transaction involving Digital's Printing Systems Business, GENICOM said Wednesday.
GENICOM said no agreement had yet been reached and the companies do not intend to make further announcements unless and until a pact is achieved.
Digital's Printer Systems Business makes and markets business-class network printers.
Analysts were not aware of the unit's revenues, but several noted that it is a relatively small part of DEC's operations, one that the company might do better without.
"It is not a major contributor to DEC's earnings," said Gary Helmig, an analyst at SoundView Financial Group.
"I believe that this (talks with GENICOM) is part of their attempt to get better focus on their core businesses," he said.
